mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Dimensionality Reduction chapter! You have built a comprehensive comparison pipeline that applies PCA, LDA, SelectKBest, and RFE to the same dataset. You learned the strengths of each method: PCA for variance preservation and noise reduction, LDA for supervised class separation, SelectKBest for fast univariate selection, and RFE for model-optimized feature subsets. Understanding when to use each technique is crucial for effective preprocessing. Use PCA for visualization and denoising, LDA for classification-oriented reduction, SelectKBest for quick filtering, and RFE when you need the best feature subset for a specific model. You are now equipped to tackle any dimensionality challenge!
